question: How many people were killed in the shooting in Stade in June 2026?

steps.content: [2026 Stade shooting] On 29 June 2026, a mass shooting took place in a youth welfare center in Stade, Lower Saxony, Germany. Six people were killed, all of them social workers for the facility or state youth welfare authority. Two people were arrested, including the alleged shooter. Police believe that the shooting was motivated by a child custody dispute. On 21 July, the suspect was found dead in his jail cell in an apparent suicide. | other articles: Stade, 2026–27 UEFA Nations League A
